note: California State Parks campground in the forest south of the east end of Donner Lake in Truckee, in three loops (Ridge, Splitrock and Creek). Trailers are limited to 24 ft. The nearest dump station is at a Chevron station about a mile away, and the lake beach is about a mile's walk by trail. --Claude
summary: Donner Memorial SP: parks.ca.gov + infosheet + 2013 map + ReserveCalifornia grid/details + imagery. $35 summer 2027 confirmed; 2027 season 05-27..09-30 (Ridge/Splitrock to Labor Day); limits trailer 24 / motorhome 28 ft; max stay 15; dump station corrected to none (Chevron a mile away); hookups confirmed none. Creekside -> not waterfront lead (loop ~55-65 m from Donner Creek under canopy). Phone option given.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade, creekside -> not waterfront, borderline): the Creek loop's north road (sites ~83-91 per the 2013 map) is ~55-65 m south of Donner Creek (~10-15 m wide) on the USGS topo, under continuous conifer canopy, with the Nature Trail between; no pad can be seen and no site can be named within ~50 m. Ground is level with the creek (3DEP 1807-1808 m), so an easy walk down exists, but the distance can't be shown inside 50 m. ReserveCalifornia lists 'Proximity to Water: 1 mile' on every site (boilerplate for the lake). Proposed evidence: 'USGS topo + Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-26: Creek loop north road ~55-65 m S of Donner Creek (39.32069,-120.23233 vs creek 39.32126,-120.23233) under canopy, Nature Trail between; no site shown within 50 m -> not waterfront. --Claude'. If the reviewer reads the map's outer sites 85-88 as within ~50 m, creekside stays.
